items.title: 补充 Parallel Wave Integration 章节
items.context: 用户同意采用组合式融合：Parallel Wave 负责只读排兵布阵，Parallel Development 消费 frozen wave snapshot 并添加 ownership、execution state、evidence freshness、merge queue enforcement、sequential proof discipline。文档必须保留 Wave 的 L0/non-authoritative 边界，避免把它描述成执行器或证明来源。

verificationEvidence.note: Whitespace and patch-format check passed after clarifying full-envelope Wave snapshot and schema marker wording.

Existing Parallel Wave report surface remains non-authoritative: authority.productionDone=false, authority.authorityChanged=false, and receiptRefs=[]; the document treats it as human-readable summary only.

Full-envelope Parallel Wave output includes schemaVersion and generatedAt, not waveSchemaVersion, while still including storyRefs, hostCandidates, evidenceRefs, mergeOrder, and authority. The document now records that source-surface schema marker distinction.
